direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale feels very Pixar, but it also has some unique aspects to it with its world-building; The direction on a microscale is surprisingly pretty dark for a Pixar movie as the film deals a lot with more mature themes, but it still has its Pixar charm; The storytelling is somewhat fresh for a Pixar movie as it follows the Pixar story template, but it also takes its own liberties to be more unique

performance.comments: Holds her own as the lead and gives a memorable performance, something you want from a Pixar lead
Fun and cute, with a good dynamic with Curda
The most obvious Dave Franco role ever cause you can spot him from a mile away since he's literally just yelling into the mic with his actual voice

cast.comments: The supporting cast doesn't really have too much material to work with, but everyone does their job in helping move the story forward

story.comments: The concept is basically Avatar, and they call this out very early in the movie; The plot structure follows the standard Pixar story template, but it drags a bit in the second half; The character writing is pretty good for the protagonist as you empathize with her struggle to try to do what is right even though everything is against her, while the remaining characters are just templated characters

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is typical of Pixar and well-written; The humor is typical for Pixar and well-written; The symbolism is surprisingly mature for a Pixar movie as it deals a lot with deforestation, along with themes of trying to do what is right despite always being shot down, so it is basically Avatar; The foreshadowing is what you expect from the Pixar team, and it is strong and helps make the story feel well-structured

score.comments: The score helps with setting the tone

editing.comments: The editing feels pretty generic, like Pixar’s B-team

animation.comments: The animation is fine from an artistic standpoint, but it honestly felt very flat, as if this movie was animated by Pixar’s B-team

review.pacing: The pacing is pretty slow as the second half drags on longer than it needs to; This movie could have been cut by 10 minutes in the second half to make it tighter
review.climax: The climax is emotionally strong and well-made, though it does feel like an adrenaline dump due to how dragged out the second half is
review.tone: The tone is surprisingly mature for a Pixar movie as it deals with more mature themes, but it still has its signature Pixar charm
review.overall: Overall, 'Hoppers' feels like a breath of fresh air from Pixar as it is a more mature movie that feels unique in its storytelling while still having the signature Pixar charm from its industry-leading story team, but the animation ultimately falls flat as it is pretty obvious this was designed by Pixar's B-team, considering most of their resources this year are going towards Toy Story 5
